howto.what: Claude 能设计端到端的 Azure IoT 和智慧城市解决方案，包括需求分析、架构设计、安全、运维、成本控制以及分阶段交付计划，并输出具体实施文档。
howto.when: 当你提出构建 Azure IoT 解决方案、智慧城市架构（如交通、照明、垃圾管理）或需要连接设备、分析数据、设置警报时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个智慧城市的 IoT 架构
say.note: 会输出参考架构、技术选型和数据流
生成包含试点、集成、规模化三个阶段

say.text: 给出安全与治理检查清单
say.note: 列出 RBAC、密钥、网络安全等要点

howto.what_en: Claude becomes an expert that designs end-to-end Azure IoT and Smart City solutions: requirements, architecture, security, operations, cost, and a phased delivery plan with concrete artifacts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to build an IoT solution on Azure, design Smart City architecture (traffic, lighting, waste), or need device connectivity, analytics, and alerts planning.

say_en.text: Design a Smart City IoT architecture for me
say_en.note: Outputs reference architecture, component choices, data flow
Generates pilot, integration, and city-scale rollout phases

say_en.text: Provide a security and governance checklist
say_en.note: Lists RBAC, secrets, network isolation controls
